protocol.split: November 26 Gemini grouped splits, screened for normalized bodies and sampled shingles
protocol.held_out_archive_sms: Disjoint within this run. Previously evaluated and class-confounded by source.
protocol.fit_selection: Rank candidate variants by recall at 2.5% FPR on expanded validation, subject to category constraint. Tie-break on fewer false positives and candidate name.
protocol.evaluation: Caution and high risk are alerts. Scoreless phishing counts as a miss. Rank metrics use the scored subset and are undefined on single-class cohorts.
protocol.scope: Research only. No model conversion or deployment.
protocol.lexical_variant_note: Compact configurations change vocabulary, n-grams, C and class weighting together. The separate source weighting and structural scaling tests are controlled comparisons.
